steps.text: Earn the other 54 trophies on the official list; the platinum is a chain reward with no objective of its own.
It arrives last, once the story, strands, collectibles, activities, feats, money and the 100% cleanup of stages 1 through 7 are all signed off.
Measure progress against the 55-entry list rather than the in-game completion percentage, since the 100% checklist behind A Long Road is only about 60% of true completion.
Front-load the story and named story missions: one playthrough is enough and there is no mission replay, so nothing story-bound can be recovered on a second lap.
When the 54th trophy lands the platinum pops automatically; free-roam continues after the story, so any open-world leftovers can still be finished afterwards.

steps.text: Complete Gone Fishing, the opening story mission of Chapter 1 — there are no prerequisites beyond starting the campaign.
It sits at the very front of the stage 1 roadmap, ahead of every chapter trophy, so a normal playthrough cannot walk past it.

steps.text: Earn a gold medal in all 42 Shooting Range challenges — silver, and the sharpest pure-aim test in stage 4.
The range is an activity type picked up alongside the story, so visit it the moment it is available and let practice overlap with the campaign.

Take the last golds in free-roam after the story, with cheats left alone since they disable trophies and saving.

Top Fun is a stage 4 activity available in free-roam rather than inside a mission, so it can be raced whenever the map is open.
Fly each course once to learn the gate order, then race it again for the win — the first pass is reconnaissance, not an attempt.

Tick the 14 venues off on a map sweep and mop up any you missed after the credits, when free-roam is fully open.
